'''Baran''' was a young noble from [[Tear]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is a foppish fellow with a sharp nose. He smokes a pipe.

== Activities ==
He is one of the young lords in the [[Stone of Tear]] playing cards with [[Mat Cauthon]] when the [[bubble of evil]] causes Mat's cards to come to life and attack Mat.{{ref/book|4|2}}

He was sent to [[Cairhien]] and when the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]] attacked, he was stabbed in the stomach with a spear and died.
